`eureka` is a command-line tool that lets you quickly record an idea using your preferred editor and have that idea stored in a git-backed ideas repository.

Think of it as a very quick way to capture short notes: run the command, write your idea, and it will be saved to your ideas repository so you can revisit it later.

echo 'alias idea="eureka"' >> ~/.zshrc
